text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. When a developer finishes writing a piece of code, another team member carefully examines it before it is merged into the main project. This process is extremely effective for catching bugs early, saving time and effort that would otherwise be spent fixing problems later. Beyond finding errors, code reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase, making the whole team more versatile. Ultimately, regular reviews build a culture of collaboration and improve overall team quality, as everyone takes greater care knowing their work will be seen.
